I'm mapping out the ships as horizontal segments per row, then checking each shot location against nearby ships row by row—starting with the shot at row6 col3, which lines up with the ship in row4.

That confirms F destroyed. Then row7 col2 hits E (since F there is already dead), row8 col8 hits G, and row10 col8 hits B (with G and E already destroyed in that column). That leaves A, C, and D still standing.
